ENGLISH: The Burning Bush
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 燃烧的荆棘

ENGLISH: Moses at Horeb
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 摩西在何烈山

ENGLISH: A shepherd follows one stray sheep up a mountain — and finds a fire that does not burn out.
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 一个牧人为了一只走失的羊上山——却遇见一团烧不尽的火焰。

ENGLISH: c. 1440 BC, in Midian, on the far side of the desert. Moses has lived here forty years, shepherding the flock of his father-in-law Jethro.
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 约公元前 1440 年，米甸，旷野的那一边。摩西在这里住了四十年，替岳父叶忒罗放羊。

ENGLISH: Moses was raised as a prince in Egypt, then fled after killing an Egyptian. He is a shepherd now, married, with a family — and God has been silent for forty years.
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 摩西在埃及王宫长大，后来杀了人，逃到旷野。如今他是牧人，有妻子有孩子，而神已经四十年没有出声。

ENGLISH: Israel is enslaved in Egypt, and God is about to speak. The bush that burns without burning up is not the point — the point is what God says about Himself, and what He asks Moses to do.
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 以色列人还在埃及做奴隶，神就要开口了。烧不坏的荆棘不是重点；重点是神怎样介绍自己，以及祂要摩西去做什么。

ENGLISH: Moses had been in Midian for forty years. The call comes not in a palace but on an ordinary workday, while he is chasing a lost sheep. God's first words are not a command but a self-introduction: I am the God of your father.
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 摩西在米甸已经四十年。呼召不是发生在王宫，而是在一个平凡的工作日——他正在追赶一只走失的羊。神开口第一句不是命令，而是自我介绍：「我是你父亲的神。」

ENGLISH: You did not receive a task. You received a presence.
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 你领受的不是一项任务，而是一位一直与你同在的神。

ENGLISH: God's call often begins with who He is, not with what you can do. Moses argued, hesitated and bargained — and God stayed. Courage is not confidence in yourself; it is trust in the One who says 'I will be with you.'
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 神的呼召往往先讲祂是谁，而不是你能做什么。摩西争辩、迟疑、讨价还价——神仍然在。勇气不是对自己有信心，而是信靠那位说「我必与你同在」的神。

ENGLISH: What “burning bush” has God put in front of you lately — an ordinary moment that felt strangely holy?
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 最近神把什么「燃烧的荆棘」放在你面前——一个平凡、却忽然变得神圣的时刻？

ENGLISH: An ordinary day that suddenly mattered
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 一个忽然变得重要的平凡日子

ENGLISH: Moses was doing his job when the bush burned. Watch your ordinary Tuesdays. Exodus 3:1
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 摩西是在上班时看见荆棘燃烧的。留意你平凡的星期二。出埃及记 3:1

ENGLISH: Something I am afraid to say yes to
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 一件我不敢答应的事

ENGLISH: God's answer to inadequacy is never 'try harder' — it is 'I will be with thee.' Exodus 3:12
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 当你说「我不配」，神从不回答「再努力一点」，祂只说：「我必与你同在。」出埃及记 3:12

ENGLISH: I am not sure I would notice
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 我不确定自己会留意到

ENGLISH: The bush burned for a while before Moses turned aside. Ask for the grace to turn aside. Exodus 3:3
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 摩西转过去看之前，荆棘已经烧了一会儿。求恩典让你愿意转身。出埃及记 3:3

ENGLISH: Drag across the dunes to gather the three scattered sheep before the sandstorm reaches the burning bush.
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 拖过沙丘，在沙暴抵达荆棘之前找回三只走散的羊。

ENGLISH: The scroll opens on dry wind and the smell of dust. Red mountains rise on every side, and a small flock of sheep picks its way across the stones.
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 书卷在干燥的风里展开，满是尘土的气味。红色的山从四面围上来，一小群羊在石头之间找路走。

SPEAKER: elias
ENGLISH: Moses has been here forty years. He was a prince once. Now he counts sheep for his father-in-law.
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 摩西在这片旷野已经四十年了。他从前是埃及的王子，如今替岳父数羊。

SPEAKER: moses
ENGLISH: One is missing. It always goes toward the high ground.
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 少了一只。它总往高处跑。

SPEAKER: elias
ENGLISH: Then we go after it. Watch your footing — the wind is getting up.
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 那就去追。脚下留神，风起来了。

ENGLISH: Go after the stray sheep yourself
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 自己去追那只走失的羊

ENGLISH: You scramble up the scree, hands scraped raw, and find a lamb trembling behind a boulder.
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 你爬上碎石坡，手掌磨破，在一块巨石后发现一只发抖的小羊。

ENGLISH: Ask Corin why God waited forty years
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 问柯林，神为何等了四十年

SPEAKER: elias
ENGLISH: “Perhaps,” he says, “because a prince had to become a shepherd before he could lead shepherds.”
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 「也许，」他说，「因为一个王子得先学会当牧人，才带得动牧人。」

ENGLISH: Pray for the lost one before climbing
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 上山之前为那只迷失的羊祷告

ENGLISH: The prayer is small and ordinary. That, you will learn, is how most of them start.
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 这个祷告又小又普通。后来你会知道，大多数祷告都是这样开始的。

ENGLISH: The sandstorm rolls across the valley like a wall. And there, ahead of it — a shrub on fire, blazing gold against the red rock.
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 沙暴像一堵墙压过山谷。就在它前面，一丛灌木正烧着，在红色岩石上闪出金光。

SPEAKER: moses
ENGLISH: It is burning. But the leaves are still green.
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 它在烧。可叶子还是绿的。

SPEAKER: elias
ENGLISH: Take off your sandals. This ground has just become different from every other ground you have stood on.
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 把鞋脱下来。你脚下这块地，跟你站过的任何地方都不一样了。

ENGLISH: Take off your sandals
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 把鞋脱下来

ENGLISH: Your bare feet feel the hot stone. It is the most honest thing you have done all day.
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 赤脚踩在滚烫的石头上。这是你今天做过最诚实的一件事。

ENGLISH: Ask Moses to cover his face
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 叫摩西蒙住脸

ENGLISH: He does — and then he looks anyway, because he cannot help it. Awe and curiosity are not enemies.
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 他蒙住脸——又忍不住从指缝里看。敬畏和好奇，本来就不冲突。

ENGLISH: Stand back and watch the flame
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 退后，静静看着那团火焰

ENGLISH: You count your breaths. The fire does not flicker. It has all the time in the world.
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 你数着自己的呼吸。火焰一动不动，好像有的是时间。

SPEAKER: voice
ENGLISH: I am the God of thy father, the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob.
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 我是你父亲的神，是亚伯拉罕的神、以撒的神、雅各的神。

ENGLISH: Moses hides his face. The bush keeps burning. No smoke, no ash, no hurry.
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 摩西蒙住脸。荆棘继续烧着。没有烟，没有灰，一点也不着急。

SPEAKER: elias
ENGLISH: Listen. He does not begin with a task. He begins with a relationship — I am the God your father knew.
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 听。祂先说的是关系，不是任务——我是你父亲的神。

ENGLISH: Whisper: “Here am I”
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 轻声说：「我在这里」

SPEAKER: elias
ENGLISH: It is the same answer Abraham gave. Some sentences are handed down like a family trade.
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 这也是亚伯拉罕当年的回答。有些话，就这么一代一代传下来了。

ENGLISH: Ask what His name is
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 问祂的名字是什么

ENGLISH: The answer comes slowly: “I AM THAT I AM” (Exodus 3:14). Not a label to hold — a presence that simply is.
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 答案慢慢浮出来：「我是我所是」（出埃及记 3:14）。这不是一个能攥在手里的名号，而是一位一直都在的神。

ENGLISH: Say nothing, and stay on your knees
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 什么也不说，只是跪着

ENGLISH: Silence is also an answer. The flame waits for you.
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 沉默也是一种回答。火焰等着你。

SPEAKER: voice
ENGLISH: I have surely seen the affliction of my people … and I am come down to deliver them. Come now therefore, and I will send thee unto Pharaoh.
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 我实在看见我百姓的困苦了……我下来是要救他们。故此，我要打发你去见法老。

SPEAKER: moses
ENGLISH: Who am I, that I should go unto Pharaoh?
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 我算什么，竟能去见法老呢？

SPEAKER: elias
ENGLISH: Notice: God does not answer “you are qualified.” He answers “I will be with you.”
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 留意：神没有回答「你够资格」，祂回答的是「我必与你同在」。

ENGLISH: The mountain is very quiet. The sandstorm has moved on. Somewhere below, a lamb bleats.
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 山上非常安静。沙暴已经过去。山下某处，一只小羊在叫。

ENGLISH: Go with him toward Egypt
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 陪他往埃及去

ENGLISH: You do not feel brave. You go anyway. That is usually what brave looks like from the inside.
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 你并不觉得自己勇敢，可你还是去了。走上去的时候，没有人会觉得自己勇敢。

ENGLISH: Give him your staff for the road
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 把你的手杖送给他上路

ENGLISH: He takes it, testing its weight. A stick is not much — but it is something to hold.
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 他接过去，掂了掂分量。一根杖算不了什么——可上路的人手里总得有点什么。

ENGLISH: Ask him to remember this mountain
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 请他记住这座山

SPEAKER: moses
ENGLISH: “I will,” he says. “Especially on the days I would rather forget.”
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 「我会的，」他说，「特别是在那些我宁愿忘掉的日子里。」

SPEAKER: elias
ENGLISH: The call did not make Moses fearless. It made him accompanied. That is the whole difference.
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 呼召并没有让摩西不再惧怕，而是让他不再孤单。区别就在这里。

ENGLISH: You look back once. The bush is still burning — quietly, patiently, with no audience at all.
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 你回头看了一眼。荆棘仍在燃烧——安静、耐心，完全没有观众。

ENGLISH: The scroll turns. Egypt is a long way off.
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 书卷翻页。埃及还很远。
